scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:front"
scripts.dev:back: npx --yes kill-port 4000 && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:front: npx --yes kill-port 5173 && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
